Record maize harvest >4M tonnes — reduced food import needs

Yuan mining tax corridor reducing USD demand

trendAnalysis.outlook: Kwacha marginally firmer into 12 Sep: USD/ZMW mid ~19.20 (open.er-api.com), vs ~19.22 a week earlier and ~18.83 a month ago — still within the broad 18.40–19.24 consolidation band, with the market absorbing post-swearing-in positioning. With re-election formalised at the 1 Sep ceremony and the MPC holding at 13.25% on 26 August, focus shifts to the make-up of the new economic team and the 2027 budget for the next leg of the currency.

news.title: Zambia Economy This Week: New Parliament, Copper Power Push, Rising Living Costs (7–11 September 2026)
news.summary: 224 newly elected MPs were sworn in on Monday 7 September, opening the Thirteenth Parliament that must pass the 2027 National Budget and the 2027–2031 Medium-Term Revenue Strategy. August inflation eased to 6.2% — the lowest since February 2018 and inside BoZ's 6–8% target band — yet the JCTR Basic Needs and Nutrition Basket for a Lusaka family of five rose to K12,000.94 in August, up K302.52 on July. President Hichilema met Vedanta Resources on Thursday 10 September, pressing Konkola Copper Mines and CopperTech to fast-track power investment for a 500,000-tonne copper target and the government's 10-gigawatt electricity goal. The kwacha traded between roughly K19.07 and K19.37 against the dollar this week, ending near K19.24, marginally softer than a week earlier, while the ERB held September fuel pump prices unchanged.
